reliability.threshold: the failure direction is closed: nothing is affirmed about a provider that was never verified, and the loss of the means of checking is a refusal rather than a pass
reliability.measured: The domain returns an empty list for a provider known to impose nothing, for one never verified, for an empty identifier, and for the five inherited Object.prototype members. The control classifies everything it reads and refuses what it cannot: more than one imposed block in the module (§14), an array element that is not a readable text part, a text carrying an escape it cannot decode, a guard with no module-level predicate of that name, a predicate that is not exactly one membership test — which is what refuses a widened or neutralised condition — a token prefix differing from the declared one, copies of the module that disagree, no copy at all, and a text differing from the declaration. Held by test/v3/provider-system-block.test.ts (16 cases) and test/v1/imposed-layers.test.ts. A declaration naming no token prefix also refuses; that one is exercised by hand and not by a test.
reliability.note: Every copy of the module under the given root is now found by walking the tree, not by enumerating two expected shapes, so a copy nested under a package outside the provider's scope is read rather than missed. What the control establishes about the condition is a name correspondence between the guard and a predicate of that name, not a proof of dataflow; the docstring says so.

operability.threshold: a refusal is readable where Preflight is read, and names what to correct without opening the provider's package
operability.measured: lint:provider-block prints, on success, the provider, the fact it matches, how many copies of the module agreed, and the file read. On a differing text it prints found against declared, each on its own line, every part of the array listed. On a differing condition it prints both token prefixes and the declared condition they came from. On absence it says the means of checking is lost rather than that nothing is imposed. An escape it cannot decode refuses in a sentence instead of an unhandled SyntaxError and a stack trace. No new presentation component: the control rides the same chained-exit path as the eight others.
operability.note: Wired into npm run check, so the refusal surfaces at the same moment as every other gate rather than on a separate command nobody runs.
